A '''woman''' was the [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Alexan|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jastro III]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was in love with the local [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] underground member [[Selas Ferr]] and put him and his group in contact with the mysterious, influential individual known as "Alexan."<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
